faq.question: Q1. What is the organisation conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences New Delhi (AIIMS New Delhi).

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post notified is Research Associate - I.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available under Project No. D-645.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 16 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a recognized MDS degree in the specialty of Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 58,000/- + 27% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must email their Curriculum Vitae (CV) along with attached certificates and mark-sheets as a single PDF file to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting based on CV, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.
